hypothesis: The two durability cuts landed on origin/main (#3283 e0c83de95 the supervisor-config persist's TS-absent fsync, #3295 87da43ea1 the install-id create's TS-absent sync_all; merged 2026-10-01, both verified in-tree at the tip; the create-window fan-out #3287 is NOT merged): the daemon's PRE-BIND bind span loses its durable-write cost in every posture, while the create windows (the create's own writes) stay unchanged. The composed expectation from the records: bind span ~3.5ms on the degraded host class (the L1 B-arm 3.46ms) vs the ~966ms A-arm with both fsyncs under the 480ms-class regime, ~1-3ms healthy; the fresh ledger's #118 baseline (record 20261001-031500 at b1c6b7a0c: fresh-cold paint 56.6/ready 306.32, daemon_spawn_to_bind 37.95; fresh-warm paint 7.05/ready 340.31, prewarm boot 81.8) carries ONE boot fsync on the TUI path and TWO on the direct-spawn path. Kevin's cold/warm-start question needs the fresh-cold + fresh-warm create windows AT THE MERGED TIP with the composed improvement live in the product.
approach: MEASUREMENT ONLY (no product bytes changed). Fresh 16c/32GB/100GB Prime VM (hillclimb-perf-postmerge-ledger kdws7x98zltzpdjqlc6wv9rk, ubuntu:22.04, rustup 1.98.1 the CI pin), origin/main verified by ls-remote and PINNED at 66e13ea53 (the exact sha built and disclosed; 28 commits past the pre-merge clean-ledger tip 3358e0016, 41 past the #118 baseline b1c6b7a0c), cargo build --release --locked --workspace rc=0 in 1m56s, staged in the r2 install layout (launcher bin/prime-agent-rust + exe-adjacent payload share/prime-agent-rust; the tip-built SHIPPED split-debug binary sha256 c995e9f4de7c72d7b7abbaa06606c08738341493aa8c318127bc5316d289e663, 56,456,232B; the tip's runtime/skills; the r2-pin bundled catalogs, provenance disclosed; package.json stamped with the tip sha; the harness version_info asserted the payload sha + revision through the launcher). THE FRESH LEDGER (the #118 method, the same startup-redecompose driver): fresh-cold + fresh-warm n=10 each, the boot-floor watcher contract (2ms process-sighting grid with python-role classification, 1ms daemon-sock stat grid + 2ms worker-sockdir grid, 5ms per-role CPU grid, first_paint + typed-echo ready + sentinel/erase validation + per-trial fixture hashes), mock-routed raw-PTY, quiet-gated, per-trial template homes, noop PTY floor per invocation. THE WIRE LEGS (the fanout lane's method): the create response span DIRECTLY on the daemon wire (spawn -> socket accept -> connect -> daemon_hello -> create request -> response wall) + the boot wall, cold-shape (fresh daemon per trial) + warm-shape (prewarmed daemon), n=10 each, served-path assertions on EVERY trial (create success, sessionFile non-empty, descriptor lifecycle ready/rootSessionId/sessionFile/createCommand.sessionPath/pid>0/token). THE SERVED-PATH FSYNCS-GONE PROOF (the -f process-partition censuses): strace -ff -tt -T -s 512 (openat,fsync,fdatasync,rename,link,linkat,execve,connect) x2 telemetry-ON (PRIME_AGENT_TELEMETRY=1, no PI_OFFLINE, no DO_NOT_TRACK) + x2 bench-default posture boots + the harness TUI-path io census leg (strace -ff, one fresh-cold trial) - boot window (spawn->socket accept) fsync census with fd->path attribution, the two writes' syscall sequences asserted served (the supervisor-config openat+rename into the expected hash dir; the install-id openat(O_CREAT|O_EXCL,0600)+linkat publish), telemetry.json/telemetry mirror landings checked. I/O advisory v1.0 at EVERY leg boundary (>=40 isolated fresh+sync_all+rename @0.5s + >=50 repeat-fsync), PHASE re-classification at every boundary, NO-CEILING in-leg labels, a 30s longitudinal watcher, spin calib pre/mid/post (0.0008s stable), noop PTY floor per invocation.
